description: prConcurrentLimit, prHourlyLimit: the 10 open pull requests and the 2 an hour of config:recommended would hold back the updates of the many tools, actions and dependencies for hours.

gitIgnoredAuthors: Biome Migrate commits the migrated biome.jsonc and the formatted files to Renovate branches as github-actions. Without this, Renovate would see the branch as modified by someone else and stop rebasing and updating it.

Refreshes mise.lock by running `mise lock`, which relocks every tool and every platform already present in the lockfile. Needed because only goreleaser and yq live in mise.toml: go, terraform and opentofu come from their idiomatic version files via the regex managers below, and those do not touch the lockfile, so their entries would go stale after every bump.
Scheduled at any time rather than the default weekly slot so the refresh lands right after such a bump instead of up to seven days later.

Automerged because the PR carries no decision: the version was already approved when its bump was merged, and nobody can review a sha256 by eye. The one signal a human could have spotted - a checksum changing while its version did not - is checked instead by the Mise Lock Check workflow, which also downloads the tools to verify the recorded sums against the real artifacts.
